name: Lucky Puma 4
author: Ratinax
description: Outlined dark green toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes translateY(-0.3em), box-shadow becomes 0 0.3em 0 #000, transform becomes translateX(calc(2em - 1em)) translateY(-0.3em). Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes to #888, transform becomes translateX(calc(2em - 1em)) translateY(-0.2em), background-color changes to #ff0000. On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 2px #888.
